cell_average: piecewise-constant L2 cell-average embedding; on nested grids M divisible by N, each original cell value is constant over exactly M//N target cells, followed by reduced QR
comparison: same eigenvectors, same common grids and same overlap metric; only the embedding changes
linear_reproduction_gate: all linear overlaps and assignment scores must reproduce subspace_overlap_analysis.json within 1e-12
profile_gate: each recomputed frozen pair profile and edge weight must agree within 1e-10
